y1: When Jesus was born in the town of Bethlehem, wise men lived in a faraway eastern country. They were smart men who studied the stars in the sky.
y2: One night, a very special star appeared. The wise men said, “A new king has been born! Let's go and worship Him.”
y4: First, the wise men came to the big city of Jerusalem and asked, “Where is the newborn king?”
y5: When King Herod heard this, he was very worried. He didn't want anyone to be a greater king than him.
y6: Herod lied: “When you find the baby, let me know, so I can go and worship Him too.” But in his heart, he wanted to hurt the baby.
y8: When the wise men set out again, the star went ahead of them and stopped over the house where the baby was. The wise men were very happy.
y9: They saw baby Jesus and His mother Mary, bowed down, and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasure chests and gave Him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
y11: That night, God told the wise men in a dream: “Do not go back to Herod.”
y12: The wise men obeyed God's word and went back to their own country by another way. God protected baby Jesus.
verse: “The wise men saw baby Jesus, bowed down, and worshiped Him.”
prayer: Lord God, we thank You for sending Jesus as the King of the whole world. Help us to joyfully worship Jesus like the wise men did. We give our hearts, our time, and our songs as gifts to Jesus. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: Bethlehem. It is the little town where Jesus was born. King David was also from this town. Bethlehem means 'house of bread'.
d1: wise men. They are smart men from the East who studied the stars. The wise men traveled a long way on camels.
d2: worship. It means to bow down with great respect and honor God. The wise men worshiped baby Jesus.
d3: Herod. He was the king of Judea at that time. He was a very jealous and suspicious man. Herod did not want a new king to be born.
d4: gold. It is the most precious metal. It is a gift given to kings. Gold shows that Jesus is King.
d5: frankincense. It is tree resin that smells good when burned. It was used in worshiping God. Frankincense reminds us that Jesus is God.
d6: myrrh. It is a bitter but sweet-smelling oil. It was used when burying the dead. Myrrh reminds us that Jesus would die for us.
d7: obey. It means to listen to what is said and do it. The wise men obeyed God's word.
